name: Bastion
description: An original heavy frame, about 24 m tall, in a cocoon of four thick curved quarter-shells. Each quarter rides on a long shell arm from a shoulder housing (link, elbow, telescoping forearm, wrist), hides a long folding leg with a grapple along its inside, carries four gimballed lift engines and has a drone bay in its bulge under a hinged cover; walking, the arms hold the quarters clear of the legs; flying, they push them out over the four corners as platforms, engines blowing down. Forward is -Z.
